_comment_cad: CAD codegen provider: auto | groq | gemini | openai | openrouter. Optional cad_model overrides the default model id for that provider.
_comment_llama: Optional: path to a GGUF model for offline reasoning. Download from https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-GGUF (recommended: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf). Also run: pip install llama-cpp-python
_comment_spotify: Optional: enables the fast Spotify Web API search path (actions/spotify_web.py) instead of relying only on the local cache + keyboard-automation fallback. Create a free app at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard with redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8899/callback, then run: python scripts/spotify_login.py
_comment_google_calendar: Optional: enables actions/calendar_action.py to read/manage your real Google Calendar. Create an OAuth 'Desktop app' client at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials, enable the Google Calendar API, add redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8900/callback, then run: python scripts/google_calendar_login.py
_comment_holiday_calendar: Optional: which public Google holiday calendar to mirror into the offline .ics (actions/calendar_sync.py). Defaults to en.indian#holiday@group.v.calendar.google.com. Find your country's id at https://calendar.google.com -> Settings -> 'Browse calendars of interest' -> Holidays, then 'Settings and sharing' -> Calendar ID.
_comment_timezone: IANA timezone used for all calendar reads/writes (actions/calendar_action.py, actions/calendar_sync.py) — Google Calendar requires this on every event or it rejects the request with 'Missing time zone definition'.
